name: SN 35210
summary: SN 35210 is an arylcyclohexylamine dissociative anesthetic drug. It was derived from ketamine with the intention of producing a shorter acting agent more suitable to be used as a stand-alone drug, whereas ketamine itself generally has to be used in combination with other drugs such as midazolam to minimise the occurrence of emergence reactions due to its hallucinogenic side effects.

pharmacology.text: In common with other short-acting anaesthetic drugs such as remifentanil and remimazolam, SN 35210 has had the chemical structure modified to incorporate a methyl ester group which is rapidly metabolised to a carboxylic acid, producing an inactive compound and thus rapidly terminating the effects of the drug.

uses.text: SN 35210 is an arylcyclohexylamine dissociative anesthetic drug. It was derived from ketamine with the intention of producing a shorter acting agent more suitable to be used as a stand-alone drug, whereas ketamine itself generally has to be used in combination with other drugs such as midazolam to minimise the occurrence of emergence reactions due to its hallucinogenic side effects.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Ketamine-like anaesthetics can cause confusion, vivid dreams or agitation on waking, raised blood pressure and nausea.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。類似K他命的麻醉藥可能造成意識混亂、甦醒時出現鮮明夢境或躁動、血壓上升與噁心。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。类似K他命的麻醉药可能造成意识混乱、苏醒时出现鲜明梦境或躁动、血压上升与恶心。

fact.en: Its design borrows the trick used in the short-acting drugs remifentanil and remimazolam: an ester group that enzymes in the blood quickly cut, switching the drug off.
fact.zh: 它的設計借用了短效藥物瑞芬太尼與瑞馬唑侖的技巧：加上一個酯基，讓血液中的酵素能迅速把它切開，使藥物失去作用。
fact.zhHans: 它的设计借用了短效药物瑞芬太尼与瑞马唑仑的技巧：加上一个酯基，让血液中的酵素能迅速把它切开，使药物失去作用。
